diagnostics.name: MissingRootInit
diagnostics.meaning: no root initialization exists.

diagnostics.name: MultipleRootInit
diagnostics.meaning: more than one root initialization exists.

diagnostics.name: MissingRootTerminal
diagnostics.meaning: no root `End` or approved terminal `ContinueAsNew` exists.

diagnostics.name: MultipleRootTerminal
diagnostics.meaning: more than one root generation terminal exists.

diagnostics.name: IncompleteSuccessfulPath
diagnostics.meaning: a reachable successful path does not converge on the generation terminal.

diagnostics.name: CapabilityNotAvailable
diagnostics.meaning: a hand-built/stale graph uses a member outside its selected mode/location.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateBranchIdentity
diagnostics.meaning: fixed branch identities collide.

diagnostics.name: MissingBranchReturn
diagnostics.meaning: a reachable successful branch/item path has no typed return.

diagnostics.name: MultipleBranchReturn
diagnostics.meaning: a branch/item has more than one return terminal.

diagnostics.name: EmptyParallelScope
diagnostics.meaning: a fixed root `Parallel` contains no authored branch.

diagnostics.name: MissingJoin
diagnostics.meaning: a fan-out has no selected join.

diagnostics.name: InvalidMergeContract
diagnostics.meaning: result/state/merge contracts do not agree.

diagnostics.name: MisplacedDecorator
diagnostics.meaning: a retry/timeout/transient decorator is repeated or has no eligible immediately preceding business step.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateWorkflowDeadline
diagnostics.meaning: `CompleteWithin` is selected more than once; the second call is primary and the first is related.

diagnostics.name: SupersededBuilderHandle
diagnostics.meaning: a root builder handle belongs to an earlier authoring epoch or has a required join pending.

diagnostics.name: JoinAlreadySelected
diagnostics.meaning: the required join stage has already selected a terminal join operation.

diagnostics.name: FrozenAuthoringSession
diagnostics.meaning: the root authoring session has already selected its generation terminal and is immutable.

diagnostics.name: ExpiredLexicalBuilderHandle
diagnostics.meaning: a callback-local nested, branch, item, leased, or scope builder escaped its lexical callback.

diagnostics.name: ConcurrentAuthoringConflict
diagnostics.meaning: another authoring operation owns the session operation gate.

diagnostics.name: NonProgressingLoop
diagnostics.meaning: a root loop cycle can repeat without business work, suspension, failure, rollover, or exit.

diagnostics.name: LeaseAncestryConflict
diagnostics.meaning: acquisition is reachable under a live capacity-reserving lexical ancestor; primary/related locations identify both scopes.

diagnostics.name: LeaseBlocksContinueAsNew
diagnostics.meaning: rollover is reached before a lexical lease scope exits.

diagnostics.name: IncompatibleStateOrResultType
diagnostics.meaning: a hand-built graph has incompatible state/result/output contracts.

diagnostics.name: CodecUnsupportedShape
diagnostics.meaning: a required persisted/detached value shape cannot use `orcacore-json-v1`.

diagnostics.name: InvalidForEachLimit
diagnostics.meaning: a hand-built fan-out bypasses positive item/concurrency bounds.

diagnostics.name: NonQuiescentContinueAsNew
diagnostics.meaning: runtime defense rejects rollover while a descendant or owned obligation remains.

diagnostics.name: LeaseAncestryViolation
diagnostics.meaning: runtime defense terminally fails before queue/pool mutation and suppresses merges/restart loops.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateNodeIdentity
diagnostics.meaning: node identities collide.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateDependency
diagnostics.meaning: one node repeats a declared dependency.

diagnostics.name: SelfDependency
diagnostics.meaning: a node depends on itself.

diagnostics.name: Cycle
diagnostics.meaning: declared edges contain a cycle.

diagnostics.name: ForeignPlanReference
diagnostics.meaning: a declared node/dependency reference belongs to another plan.

diagnostics.name: MissingMapInput
diagnostics.meaning: a node has no mapping delegate.

diagnostics.name: DuplicateMapInput
diagnostics.meaning: a node assigns mapping more than once.

failures.owner: opaque mapper access/projector failure before child start

ownership.family: Workflow strong values (all §17.2.1 values except `DagNodeId` and `DagRunId`), workflow authoring/definitions/references, ordinary handles/events/results/errors
Lease/pool statuses, snapshots, closed resize result, governance records/stream/append result
